decoder: Valid-content maximum plus signed quarter-cell neighbour offset, then inverse actual rounded crop scale.
reference_use: Gaussian targets are constructed at annotated reference corners, solely to test representation and decoder capacity. These are synthetic target responses, not model predictions.

frozen666.interpretation: Synthetic reference-target heatmaps passed through the fixed decoder; measures representation/decoder capacity, not achieved network accuracy or a prediction method.
